customer_statement: Our 600 GB nightly export is timing out again.

historical_memory.lesson: For very large nightly batch exports with high concurrency, a longer timeout does not fix the root saturation problem; the workload must be restructured or chunked.

expected_behavior.reason: Historical memory indicates that large nightly batch exports under high concurrency saturate the system, so chunking the export into asynchronous segments is the preferred remedy.
expected_behavior.lesson: Historical memory can guide the next decision when the new case matches the same failure pattern.
